account.status.description: Get GTmetrix account status, credits, and plan capabilities.
account.status.title: Get account status

browsers.get.description: Get a single GTmetrix browser by ID, including platform and testing capabilities. Maps to GTMETRIX_GET_BROWSER.
browsers.get.title: Get browser

browsers.list.description: List GTmetrix browsers that can be used for tests.
browsers.list.title: List browsers

healthcheck.description: Validate the GTmetrix API key with GET /status.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

locations.get.description: Get a single GTmetrix test location by ID.
locations.get.title: Get location

locations.list.description: List GTmetrix test locations available to the connected account.
locations.list.title: List locations

pages.delete.description: Permanently delete a GTmetrix page and all of its reports. Maps to GTMETRIX_DELETE_PAGE.
pages.delete.title: Delete page

pages.get.description: Get a monitored GTmetrix page by slug, including URL, analysis options, and latest report. Maps to GTMETRIX_GET_PAGE.
pages.get.title: Get page

pages.latest_report.get.description: Get the most recent report for a monitored GTmetrix page. Maps to GTMETRIX_GET_PAGE_LATEST_REPORT.
pages.latest_report.get.title: Get page latest report

pages.list.description: List monitored GTmetrix pages with pagination, sort, and JSON:API filters. Maps to GTMETRIX_GET_PAGES.

filter_created.description: Filter pages by created timestamp or comparison (for example 1617680457).

filter_url.description: Fuzzy URL filter for monitored pages.

sort.description: Sort by created or latest_report_time. Prepend - for reverse.

pages.list.title: List pages

pages.reports.list.description: List reports belonging to a monitored GTmetrix page. Maps to GTMETRIX_GET_PAGE_REPORTS.

filter_gtmetrix_grade.description: Filter reports by GTmetrix letter grade.

sort.description: Sort by created, expires, performance_score, or structure_score. Prepend - for reverse.

pages.reports.list.title: List page reports

pages.retest.description: Start a new test using the page's latest analysis options. Maps to GTMETRIX_RETEST_PAGE.
pages.retest.title: Retest page

reports.delete.description: Permanently delete a GTmetrix report and its resources. Maps to GTMETRIX_DELETE_REPORT.
reports.delete.title: Delete report

reports.get.description: Get a GTmetrix report by slug, including scores, timings, and resource links. Maps to GTMETRIX_GET_REPORT.
reports.get.title: Get report

reports.resource.get.description: Get an authenticated report artifact such as lighthouse.json, net.har, screenshot.jpg, or report.pdf. Maps to GTMETRIX_GET_REPORT_RESOURCE. JSON artifacts parse as objects; binary artifacts are not JSON and fail the json response contract.

resource_name.description: Report resource name (for example lighthouse.json or screenshot.jpg).

reports.resource.get.title: Get report resource

reports.retest.description: Start a new test using the same analysis parameters as a completed report. Maps to GTMETRIX_RETEST_REPORT.
reports.retest.title: Retest report

simulated_devices.get.description: Get a GTmetrix simulated device by ID, including viewport, user agent, and pixel ratio. Maps to GTMETRIX_GET_SIMULATED_DEVICE.
simulated_devices.get.title: Get simulated device

simulated_devices.list.description: List GTmetrix simulated device profiles available for tests. Maps to GTMETRIX_GET_SIMULATED_DEVICES.
simulated_devices.list.title: List simulated devices

tests.get.description: Get a GTmetrix test by ID while it is pending (HTTP 200). Completed tests return HTTP 303, which the runner outbound boundary blocks; use tests.list or reports.get after completion. Maps to GTMETRIX_GET_TEST.
tests.get.title: Get test

tests.list.description: List GTmetrix tests from the last 24 hours with pagination and filters. Maps to GTMETRIX_GET_TESTS.

filter_created.description: Filter tests by creation UNIX timestamp.

filter_finished.description: Filter tests by finish UNIX timestamp.

filter_started.description: Filter tests by start UNIX timestamp.

sort.description: Sort by created, started, or finished. Prepend - for reverse.

tests.list.title: List tests

tests.start.description: Start a new GTmetrix performance test for a URL. Maps to GTMETRIX_START_TEST.

allow_url.description: Only load resources matching these URL patterns.

block_url.description: Prevent loading resources matching these URL patterns.

browser_rotate.description: Swap viewport width and height: 0 off, 1 on.

httpauth_password.description: Password for HTTP access authentication on the tested page.

httpauth_username.description: Username for HTTP access authentication on the tested page.

report.description: Report type: lighthouse, legacy, both, or metrics-only.

stop_onload.description: Stop the test at window.onload: 0 off, 1 on.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL to test.

tests.start.title: Start test

adaptations: Returns raw JSON:API under data instead of the upstream status-attributes unwrap.
browser_id is URL-encoded as a path segment on GET /browsers/{browser_id}.
Returns the raw JSON:API collection under data.
Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /status rather than a credit-consuming URL test.
location_id is URL-encoded as a path segment.
Returns the raw JSON:API collection under data.
DELETE /pages/{page_id} permanently removes the page and its reports. Official success is HTTP 200 with a JSON:API identifier body.
page_id is URL-encoded as a path segment on GET /pages/{page_id}.
GET /pages/{page_id}/latest-report returns a report JSON:API object.
Composio's opaque filter string is expressed as official filter[url], filter[location], filter[browser], filter[monitored], and filter[created] query parameters.
page_size/page_number map to JSON:API page[size]/page[number].
GET /pages/{page_id}/reports with official JSON:API sort, page, and filter query parameters.
POST /pages/{page_id}/retest with an empty body. Success is HTTP 202 and a queued test JSON:API object.
DELETE /reports/{report_id}. Official success is HTTP 200 with a JSON:API identifier body.
report_id is the official report slug on GET /reports/{report_id}.
GET /reports/{report_id}/resources/{resource_name} using official resource names.
JSON artifacts (lighthouse.json, net.har, analysis-options) parse under data. Binary artifacts are not JSON.
POST /reports/{report_id}/retest with an empty body. Success is HTTP 202.
GET /simulated-devices/{simulated_device_id}.
GET /simulated-devices returns the raw JSON:API collection under data.
GET /tests/{test_id} while pending returns HTTP 200.
Completed tests return HTTP 303 See Other; the runner HTTP boundary blocks 3xx, so this operation does not follow the report redirect.
Composio filter_* fields map onto official filter[state], filter[browser], filter[location], and timestamp filters.
POST /tests with JSON:API {data:{type:test,attributes}} and Content-Type application/vnd.api+json.
Composio location/browser/simulate_device names are the official attribute keys. 0/1 flags match the documented integer enums.
Success is HTTP 202.
